verdict.rationale: Preventing user data from being used for AI training is a fair privacy-posture question for an AI-powered research engine like Consensus. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions a training opt-out, a no-training policy, or any data-use control. The pack covers search, library, API/MCP and pricing features only, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
